tools.name: search_facilities
tools.description: Find licensed nursing homes, assisted living and memory care near a US town, county or ZIP, from state and Medicare public records. Results come in the same order as the search on kovante.com. Every home links to its full record on Kovante.

tools.name: get_facility
tools.description: The public record of one facility on Kovante: address, license, capacity, memory care, phone where the page shows one, and Medicare ratings for nursing homes. Give its Kovante address or the id from search_facilities.

tools.name: questions_to_ask
tools.description: The questions Kovante suggests asking a facility on the phone, for a care type. The public record does not answer these.

tools.name: compare
tools.description: Put 2 to 4 facilities side by side, in the order given, with the same public record fields. No score or ranking.
